factSources.text: With Venus in Libra, Venus is at home, so relationship intelligence, social grace, and aesthetic balance are strong. You value partnership that feels reciprocal and elegant.

factSources.text: Venus describes attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, money, comfort, desire, and the conditions that help connection feel worth choosing. It shows what someone is drawn toward and what helps affection become real rather than only appealing. Venus moves through all twelve signs in about a year, with retrograde cycles that ask for review around love, value, beauty, money, and desire. Its sign describes the style of relating; its house shows where ease, attraction, and value become active. With Venus in Libra, you value balance, harmony, and partnership in love. You are diplomatic and fair-minded in your relationships and are drawn to beauty and charm. Your sense of romance involves a deep appreciation for cooperation and shared experiences.

eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Love and value meet intensity. All-or-nothing attraction, deep desire, and a strong pull toward control in relationships. The trine makes this a natural strength: Depth and devotion in love, used deliberately. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

Connection and value meet disruption and freedom. Attraction runs electric, sudden, and unattached to convention. The trine makes this a natural strength: Exciting, unconventional bonds and an original aesthetic; freedom inside closeness. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
